facts.fact: A defective-product complaint can be registered with the National Consumer Helpline (Department of Consumer Affairs) at the pre-litigation stage
facts.quote: National Consumer Helpline (NCH) is the grievance redressal mechanism of the Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India. NCH has emerged as a single point of access for consumers across the country at the pre-litigation stage.

facts.fact: NCH channels include toll-free 1915, the NCH app and the web portal
facts.quote: using toll-free numbers 1915 or 1800-11-4000 , as well as through WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH App, web portal and UMANG App.

facts.fact: The NCH web portal is consumerhelpline.gov.in
facts.quote: For registration go to the web portal http://consumerhelpline.gov.in and click on the login link and then signup giving details required, verify through your email.

summary: NCH route and channels (1915 / app / consumerhelpline.gov.in) in the turns are confirmed; turns unchanged.
